q1.question: Hi, my parcel SB4K2P9QXT has said In transit since Tuesday and it's going from Lagos to Abuja. Is it lost? What should I do?
q1.answer:
Hello. Deliveries between Lagos and Abuja take 2 to 3 working days, and a parcel can show In transit for up to 48 hours during transport between cities without a new scan. This is normal, so your parcel is not considered lost. 

I cannot see live parcel locations from here. If your parcel has had no new scan for more than 72 hours, please open a tracking request in the app under Help > My parcel > Tracking problem so the hub team can look into it for you.

q3.question: My vase arrived broken yesterday. The delivery was due on Monday. Can I still get my money back?
q3.answer:
Hello, I am sorry to hear that your vase arrived broken. Yes, you can still make a claim, as you are within the 7-day window from your expected delivery date.

Here is what to do in the app:
1. Go to Help > My parcel > Make a claim.
2. Upload clear photos of the broken vase, the packaging and the outside of the parcel before throwing anything away.

Claims are reviewed within 3 working days. If your claim is approved, the payout will be sent to your original payment method.

Please open the app and submit your claim under Help > My parcel > Make a claim to get started.
